recognize_zh: 兩顆組織球有大量淡灰藍色、邊界不清的細胞質，下方那顆細胞質內含兩顆深染圓形核（被吞噬的有核紅血球或淋巴球）與數個血小板大小的顆粒，屬噬血現象，配合臨床可提示家族性 HLH。
features: Two histiocytes with abundant, pale gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Oval nuclei with fine reticular chromatin
Lower histiocyte contains two dense round engulfed nuclei and small platelet-sized particles
Scattered small dark nucleated red cells and lymphocytes in the background
Red cells show refractile drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and oval nuclei with fine chromatin. One histiocyte contains two phagocytosed dense round nuclei, likely nucleated red cells or lymphocytes, along with small platelet-sized fragments. Background red cells show refractile drying artifact. Findings represent hemophagocytosis; in an infant or child with fever, cytopenias and splenomegaly, together with genetic testing (PRF1, UNC13D, STX11, STXBP2) and impaired NK/cytotoxic function, this supports familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; familial HLH is defined by biallelic mutations or defective degranulation/perforin expression.
Langerhans cells have grooved, reniform nuclei and are CD1a/langerin positive, and are not typically phagocytic of intact cells.

ddx.dx: Macrophages with transfused red cells or debris
ddx.vs: Occasional phagocytosis after transfusion is common and nonspecific; HLH requires diagnostic clinical and laboratory criteria.
Tingible body macrophages contain irregular apoptotic nuclear fragments rather than intact round nuclei of hematopoietic cells.
